Croatia have no players suspended for this match, and they will welcome Ivan Perisic back into their squad, with the experienced attacker serving a ban against England.

Luka Modric could be introduced into the starting side, having featured off the bench last time out, with the 41-year-old in line to win his 208th cap. [...] There could also be an introduction into the team for the experienced Tomas Soucek.

## We say: Croatia 2-1 Czech Republic [...] Ante Budimir is an option in the final third of the field, but the expectation is that Igor Matanovic will continue through the middle for the home side.

Czech Republic, meanwhile, will be missing Ladislav Krejci, with the centre-back picking up his second red card of this Nations League against Spain.

Adam Hlozek has scored five times in 51 appearances for his country, and the 24-year-old is expected to continue in the final third of the field.

Santi Denia's side have lost all five matches after a 2-0 home defeat to Spain, but it is their discipline that is seemingly their biggest issue.

Czech Republic have had three players sent off across their last four games, including captain Ladislav Krejci twice following his red against La Roja.

He is subsequently suspended for this one, where the visitors must win to avoid the risk of automatic relegation to League B.

## Croatia vs. Czech Republic form guide & betting tips [...] Now, Slaven Bilic's side are just trying to keep afloat in League A, and avoiding defeat to the Czech Republic would ensure a third-placed finish.

Croatia seemingly have no fresh concerns following their trip to Wembley, so should be able to field their strongest possible team, potentially featuring Ivan Perisic following his return from suspension.

data.title: England v Croatia: Prediction, team news, lineups and odds
data.content:
Harry Kane will lead the line at Wembley and earn his 126th cap, surpassing the previous appearance record held by Peter Shilton.

## Croatia team news

Since naming his squad for the games against England and the Czech Republic, Slaven Bilic has had to deal with a series of withdrawals.

Josip Sutalo, Martin Pongracic, Kristijan Jakic, Andrej Kramaric and Franjo Ivanovic have all declared themselves unavailable.

### POPULAR ON FOOTBALL365 [...] Ezri Konsa has been ruled out of the Croatia game due to a knee injury, although he will return to full training before England’s fixture against Spain.

Bournemouth’s James Hill has now been added to the senior squad for the first time, joining fellow uncapped players Jobe Bellingham, Josh King and Jason Steele.

Myles Lewis-Skelly picked up a yellow card in both of the games against the Czech Republic in the last international break and now has to serve a one-match ban. [...] Following the win at the World Cup and the win in Rijeka, England are 5/19 favourites to make it three wins out of three against Croatia in 2026.

Croatia are 11/1 to secure all three points at Wembley, while The Draw is 6/1.

To win Nations League A Group 3, Spain are strong favourites at 2/9, and England are quoted at 9/2.

In the outright Nations League betting, Spain head the market at 2/1 ahead of 3/1 France, 4/1 England and 11/2 Portugal.
